# h3_lb (Data Source)

Looks up a load balancer by `project_id` + `id` or `project_id` + `name`. Requires API-key (HMAC) access to the load balancer API; as of 0.3.0 h3lb is reachable only from the console (backend gap), so calls fail with 401/404 until it is published on api.h3llo.cloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "h3_lb" "web" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  name       = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Load balancer ID; or set `name`.
- `name` (String) Name; or set `id`.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID); the provider default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) Balancing algorithm.
- `eip_id` (String) Elastic IP of the load balancer (LB Basic); null for legacy lb-svc load balancers.
- `endpoint` (String) Endpoint.
- `external_ip` (String) Public IP address.
- `listener` (Attributes List) Listeners. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--listener))
- `status` (String) `PENDING`, `CREATING`, `RUNNING`, `DELETING` or `FAILED`.
- `subnet_name` (String) Subnet the load balancer runs in.
- `targets` (List of String) Target IP addresses.

<a id="nestedatt--listener"></a>
### Nested Schema for `listener`

Read-Only:

- `port` (Number) Public port.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol.
- `target_port` (Number) Target port.
